description: Given injections f from A to B and g from B to A and a fixed subset X for the double-complement operator, there is a bijection agreeing with f on X and with the inverse of g off X; its images are the prescribed complementary pieces.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Relations.fixed_point_bijection.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α ↪ β) (g : β ↪ α)
  (X : Set α) (hX : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Relations.comparisonOperator (⇑f) (⇑g) X = X) :
  ∃ e, (∀ a ∈ X, e a = f a) ∧ (∀ a ∉ X, g (e a) = a) ∧ ⇑e '' X = ⇑f '' X ∧ ⇑e '' Xᶜ = (⇑f '' X)ᶜ
